title: Logspace Oracles Yield Polynomial Space
statement: Let $L$ be a language of binary strings, let $$ be a nondeterministic register program with $m$ registers and access to $d$ oracle languages $A_j$, and suppose its finite set of control states has decidable equality. Assume every $A_j$ is in $	ext{LOGSPACE}$. For some natural numbers $C_0,c_0$, suppose that for every input $x$ there is a length $N$ such that every choice string of length $N$ makes the program halt, and every configuration before step $N$ along such a run satisfies the program's validity conditions and has each register's binary representation (of the register value plus one) of length at most $C_0(|x|+1)^{c_0}$. Suppose also that $x\in L$ exactly when some choice string of length $N$ makes the program answer yes. Then $L$ belongs to $	ext{NPSPACE}$, the union over natural $c$ of languages decidable in nondeterministic space $n^c+1$.
